title: Name the type of a value
objective: Write of type after a value to state its type, for numbers, decimals, booleans, texts and lists.

body.text: Lagom works out the type of most values for you. You can also write it yourself with of type after the value, as in 0 of type number. The compiler checks that the value really has that type, so a mistake is reported before the program runs.

body.title: Typed values
body.code:
make changing attempts equal to 0 of type number
say attempts

make ratio equal to 0.5 of type decimal
say ratio

make enabled equal to true of type boolean
say enabled

make title equal to "Lagom" of type text
say title

body.text: A list has its type written as a list of the item type, and a map as a map from the key type to the value type. The type goes after the value in the same way.

body.title: Typed lists
body.code:
make names equal to a list of "Ana" of type a list of text
say first of names

body.prompt: The program stores 0.5 without saying what kind of value it is. Give the ratio a type and the program should still print 0.5.
body.starter:
make ratio equal to 0.5
say ratio
body.solution:
make ratio equal to 0.5 of type decimal
say ratio
